purpose: Offline geometry/kinematics witness search, not NoMaD evaluation

search.method: Continuous SE(2) forward-arc Hybrid A* with quantized duplicate pruning
search.goal: World XY disk from scenario; goal yaw unconstrained
search.wall_rule: Original corridor_clearance > 0 with radius; 0.02m margin applies to obstacles
search.side_rule: Cross dynamic center-X plane west-to-east once, above/below inflated Y face; never return west of plane; reach goal east of full inflated box
search.notes: Subset of allowed controls, no in-place turn primitive; bin pruning and finite budgets are incomplete. Settings apply only to this checker.
